name: io.github.auragridcorp-rgb/auragrid
description: Bitcoin fee and Lightning data (L402, free samples) and U.S. EIA/USGS/NOAA feeds, signed.

environmentVariables.name: AURAGRID_MAX_SATS
environmentVariables.description: Per-payment cap in sats; required only to buy paid feeds

environmentVariables.name: AURAGRID_BUDGET_SATS
environmentVariables.description: Optional total spend cap in sats

environmentVariables.name: LND_REST_URL
environmentVariables.description: Your LND REST URL (only to pay)

environmentVariables.name: LND_TLS_CERT
environmentVariables.description: Path to LND's TLS certificate (only to pay)

environmentVariables.name: LND_MACAROON_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to a pay-and-decode-only macaroon (only to pay)
